name: Winterberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Winterberg (a saint before buildings on white).
history: Municipal flag of Winterberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Winterberg arms — saint before buildings on white
